# Close wrap, Thu Oct 15, 2026 (Research Inc., ~4:30 PM ET)

**Hot PPI, but rotation beats the tape: Dow leads; AI/optics still soft.**

1. **Indexes (yfinance):** SPY 771.79 (+0.28%), QQQ 728.00 (−0.13%), DIA 521.18 (+1.08%), IWM 275.05 (+1.36%). Dow ~+550 pts on Nike/HD/WMT; S&P +0.3%; Nasdaq near flat after an early AI dip. ([Investopedia](https://www.investopedia.com/stock-market-today-dow-jones-s-and-p-500-10152026-12174789), [Reuters wrap](https://financialnewsletter.com/sp-500-near-flat-2/))
2. **Why:** Sep PPI +1.3% MoM / +6.3% YoY (biggest MoM since Mar 2022) kept hike odds alive; rotation into into health care/staples away from AI debt. ([X News](https://x.com/i/trending/2110735422804357133))
3. **Sectors:** XLV +1.86%, XLB +1.79%, XLY +1.71%, XLF +1.38%, XLP +0.72%; XLK −0.65%, XLE −1.58%. SOXX −0.91%.
4. **Covered:** WMT 117.87 (+1.47%, DB Buy); UNH 406.67 (+2.79%); BLK 1120.78 (+4.38%); ASML +0.45%; AMT +1.09%, CCI +0.78%. AI: NVDA −1.84%, AMD −1.50%, TSM −1.80%, LITE −2.99%, COHR −4.83%. CRWV +5.94% / ORCL +3.00% bounced — still avoid. Airlines green despite oil; BAC +0.6%.
5. **Oil / rates:** WTI ~$97.97 (+$2.88; Hormuz + EIA −8.6M crude); Brent ~$105.92. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/15/oil-prices-today-brent-wti.html)) 10y ~5.09%; VIX 16.49.
6. **AH:** None covered. Tomorrow: import prices 8:30 ET; industrial production 9:15 ET; monthly opex. Next: NFLX 10/20 AMC, TSLA/IBM 10/21 AMC; FOMC 10/28.

## Ideas (long-only, swing)
- **WMT**, swing: DB upgrade follow-through (+1.5%) as staples bid. Conf: med. Risk: gap fade; multiples compress if yields spike.
- **UNH**, swing: +2.8% on EPS raise + XLV rotation. Conf: med. Risk: MA/policy headlines; extended run.
- **BLK**, swing: +4.4% on AUM/inflows while tech soft. Conf: med. Risk: fee hit if drawdown deepens.
